summary: The proposed patch changes the behavior of `Contains.as_set` to return the set it contains, which resolves the immediate issue but may introduce broader behavioral changes.

issues.description: Changing `Contains.as_set` to return the set it contains may break existing code that relies on the current behavior of raising `NotImplementedError`. This could lead to unexpected behavior in parts of the codebase that assume `Contains.as_set` will always raise an error.

While the patch addresses the specific issue, there are no additional tests provided to ensure that the new behavior does not introduce regressions or unintended side effects elsewhere in the codebase.
